title: Edge AI Hardware Porting Frameworks: A Comprehensive Survey
abstract: We review lightweight compilation, operator fusion, and 8-bit quantisation pipelines for porting Deep Learning models to resource-constrained microcontrollers.

title: Machine Learning in Healthcare Diagnostics & Clinical Prediction
abstract: A comprehensive study on vision transformer architectures applied to medical imaging, pathology classification, and diagnostic outcome prediction.

title: Ethics, Explainability, and Auditing in Medical Artificial Intelligence
abstract: Frameworks for bias mitigation, saliency-map explainability, and regulatory compliance in automated clinical diagnostic decision support systems.

title: Optimizing On-Device Neural Execution on Heterogeneous Microcontrollers
abstract: Presents runtime execution scheduling, DMA memory management, and dynamic scratchpad allocation routines for low-power edge NPU accelerators.

title: Benchmark Protocols for Edge Acceleration Frameworks
abstract: Establishes standardized benchmark metrics for measuring inference latency, peak SRAM usage, thermal throttling, and energy per operation.

title: Automated Model Compression & Hardware-Aware Neural Search
abstract: Explores mixed-precision NAS algorithms targeting ARM Cortex-M microcontrollers with sub-millisecond execution constraints.

title: Privacy-Preserving Federated Learning for Multi-Hospital Healthcare Systems
venue: IEEE Journal of Biomedical & Health Informatics
abstract: Proposes differential privacy mechanisms and secure aggregation protocols for collaborative training of medical diagnostic models across hospitals.

title: Communication-Efficient Federated Optimization in Heterogeneous Networks
abstract: Presents gradient compression and adaptive client sampling methods to accelerate federated learning convergence under non-IID data distributions.

title: Quantum Machine Learning Algorithms for High-Dimensional Datasets
abstract: Evaluates parameterized quantum circuits and quantum kernels for classification tasks on NISQ-era quantum processors.

title: Hybrid Quantum-Classical Neural Networks for Signal Processing
abstract: Designs variational quantum eigensolver layers coupled with classical CNN backbones for complex physical signal analysis.

title: Real-Time Sensor Fusion & Perception in Autonomous Driving
venue: IEEE Transactions on Intelligent Transportation Systems
abstract: Integrates LiDAR point clouds and HD camera feeds using spatial-temporal attention mechanisms for robust object detection in adverse weather.

title: Adversarial Robustness & Intrusion Detection in Edge IoT Networks
abstract: Analyzes adversarial perturbation attacks against lightweight intrusion detection classifiers deployed on industrial IoT gateways.
